subject: reasoning
question:
Which letter cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

DKBN, ENWS, ?, GTMC, HWHH
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First two letters → (1) and (3) are added to first and second letters respectively according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Last two letters → (5) is subtracted from and added to the third and fourth letter respectively according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90586c29075b69c2dbcf95f67e253135a0cb22e01d7646f036eefcea2929c8ab.png] 

​Hence, "**FQRX**" is the correct answer.
